morning2_start.name: {name}
morning2_start.text: *Day two. The uniform feels a bit more comfortable than yesterday. — So do my steps.*

morning2_dain_1.name: {name}
morning2_dain_1.text: *The moment I open the classroom door — something slams into my back.*

morning2_dain_3.name: Dain
morning2_dain_3.text: Haha, from that?! You need to work out more!

morning2_dain_4.name: {name}
morning2_dain_4.text: Isn't it a bit early for this much energy?

morning2_dain_5.name: Dain
morning2_dain_5.text: This is normal! You're the one running low!

morning2_dain_6.name: {name}
morning2_dain_6.text: *If there's a world where this volume at 8 AM is normal, Dain would be its president.*

morning2_note_1.name: {name}
morning2_note_1.text: *I'm about to sit down when — I spot a folded note on my desk.*

morning2_note_2.name: {name}
morning2_note_2.text: *'Come to the library annex at lunch. — Yuna'*

morning2_note_3.name: {name}
morning2_note_3.text: *Same neat handwriting as yesterday. Short. And the location is specific. — The library 'annex'? That's a different place from yesterday.*

morning2_seo_1.name: {name}
morning2_seo_1.text: *I'm about to pocket the note when — a familiar voice from the hallway.*

morning2_seo_4.name: {name}
morning2_seo_4.text: The student council president comes all the way to the classroom to say hi?

morning2_seo_5.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_5.text: It's a patrol. — And an attendance check.

morning2_minsu_1.name: {name}
morning2_minsu_1.text: *She didn't stop walking. But her eyes were definitely on me. The moment Seoyeon turned the corner — I thought I saw her smile drop. Imagining it?*

morning2_minsu_1b.name: {name}
morning2_minsu_1b.text: *I'm staring at the hallway where Seoyeon disappeared — when Minsu turns around behind me.*

morning2_minsu_3.name: Minsu
morning2_minsu_3.text: Dude, two days as a transfer student and the student council president comes to greet you? I've been here a year and she won't even make eye contact.

morning2_dain_claim_2.name: Minsu
morning2_dain_claim_2.text: ...That's true, but that's not the point.

morning2_dain_claim_4.name: Dain
morning2_dain_claim_4.text: The student council president is interested in the transfer student too? Popular guy!

morning2_dain_claim_6.name: Dain
morning2_dain_claim_6.text: I found you first, so you're our transfer student! Dibs! I called dibs!

morning2_break_transition.name: {name}
morning2_break_transition.text: *Break time. Stepped out into the hallway.*

morning2_break_1.name: {name}
morning2_break_1.text: *Can you call dibs on a person? — But I don't mind it. That's a little scary.*

morning2_seo_dust_1.name: {name}
morning2_seo_dust_1.text: *Break after first period. I pass Seoyeon in the hallway. She stops. Looks at my shoulder.*

morning2_seo_dust_3.name: {name}
morning2_seo_dust_3.text: *Seoyeon's hand brushes my shoulder. There's no hesitation in the way she dusts it off.*

morning2_seo_dust_4.name: Seoyeon
morning2_seo_dust_4.text: You had something on your clothes.

morning2_dain_react_1.name: {name}
morning2_dain_react_1.text: *The touch on my shoulder registers a beat too late. — Probably not because of the dust.*

morning2_dain_react_2.name: {name}
morning2_dain_react_2.text: *Seoyeon walks away like nothing happened. Dain's voice comes from behind.*

morning2_dain_react_3.name: Dain
morning2_dain_react_3.text: Hey! What was that?! Did she just touch your shoulder?!

morning2_dain_react_6.name: {name}
morning2_dain_react_6.text: *There probably was. Maybe. — But I don't think that's the point.*

morning2_end.name: {name}
morning2_end.text: *That person who never approached anyone first in a year — came to me first.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_1.text: Oh, {name}. Come to the faculty office for a sec.

hidden_homeroom_d2_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_3.text: Looked at your old transcript. Your Korean grades were solid. You like reading?

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1.text: *Reading. So she even checks report cards.*
choices: What about you? What do you read?

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice1_a.text: *pausing briefly* ...Mystery novels. Not the whodunit kind — the ones that trace the motive.

hidden_homeroom_d2_6.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_6.text: *The drawer. Did she just glance at it? — Through the crack I can see a stack of papers. Looks like manuscript pages.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_7.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_7.text: How's the adjustment? Better than yesterday?

hidden_homeroom_d2_8.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8.text: Dain's loud, right? — She's always like that. But there's a difference between a kid who makes a fuss and one who just has too much energy.

hidden_homeroom_d2_10.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_10.text: Well, teachers worrying about students is just part of the job. Strictly professional.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2.text: *She says it's work, but there's still a smile in her eyes.*
choices: For work, you look awfully happy about it
Thanks for looking out for me

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_a.text: *Covers her mouth with her coffee cup* ...Expression management failure. Fine, go ahead.

hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_choice2_b.text: *waving hand dismissively* Come on, stop that. It's embarrassing. ...Go on, get going.

hidden_homeroom_d2_11.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_11.text: ...Giving the transfer student special treatment — the others would talk.

hidden_homeroom_d2_12.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_12.text: *Leaving the faculty office — I can't stop thinking about those papers in the drawer.*

morning2_greet_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
morning2_greet_seo_1.text: What you said on the rooftop yesterday — still valid?

morning2_greet_seo_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_seo_2.text: *Seoyeon came to me first. Her usual composed tone, but with a hint of wanting confirmation.*

morning2_greet_seo_others_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_seo_others_2.text: *Two subtle reactions. — Should I notice, or pretend I didn't?*

morning2_greet_dain_1.name: Dain
morning2_greet_dain_1.text: Hey! Yesterday was fun, let's do something again today!

morning2_greet_dain_others_yuna.name: {name}
morning2_greet_dain_others_yuna.text: *Can't tell if it's sarcasm or admiration. Yuna doesn't react. But the hand writing a note has stopped.*

morning2_greet_dain_others_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_dain_others_2.text: *Laughed it off, but — Seoyeon's remark lingers.*

morning2_greet_yuna_1.name: {name}
morning2_greet_yuna_1.text: *About to sit down — a folded note on my desk. '...Thank you for yesterday.'*

morning2_greet_yuna_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_yuna_2.text: *Yuna's handwriting. One sentence longer than yesterday. — On the back, in tiny letters: 'Library annex at lunch.'*

morning2_greet_yuna_others_seo.name: {name}
morning2_greet_yuna_others_seo.text: *She's smiling. But her eyes stop on the note.*

morning2_greet_yuna_others_2.name: {name}
morning2_greet_yuna_others_2.text: *I fold the note and hold it in my hand. — For some reason, it feels precious.*

morning2_break_transition_b.name: {name}
morning2_break_transition_b.text: *The homeroom teacher is standing by the classroom door. Holding the attendance sheet, she glances toward the door — and our eyes meet.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_1_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_1_c.text: No, just checking your transfer paperwork. — Administrative stuff.

hidden_homeroom_d2_2_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_2_b.text: *I headed to the faculty office with the teacher.* *Her desk is in the corner. Papers and a coffee mug on the desk, and — a drawer slightly ajar.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_c.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_c.text: *Novels. A Korean teacher reading novels is natural, but why does she seem reluctant to say it?*

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_e.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_e.text: *Strange question. We were talking about grades, so why the sudden pivot to 'writing'?*

hidden_homeroom_d2_3_g.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_3_g.text: *The teacher hesitates briefly. Her gaze drifts toward the drawer — then snaps right back.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_7_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_7_b.text: A lot better. I like the people in class.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_b.text: Sounds like Dain is pretty famous if you know about her.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_c.text: Famous isn't the word... *Takes a sip of coffee* More like someone I worry about.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_d.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_d.text: *'Someone I worry about.' — The teacher worries about Dain. Does she know something?*

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_e.text: *Setting down her coffee* ...Anyway, nothing to worry about. You're doing fine.

hidden_homeroom_d2_8_f.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_8_f.text: *She hid her mouth but fiddles with her cup for no reason. This person also shows it when they're flustered.*

hidden_homeroom_d2_11_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d2_11_b.text: *Like a mutter, when no one's listening.*
